meta.title: Shanghai Ink
meta.subtitle: Five chapters across Shanghai's layered past
meta.description: A continuous ink-wash journey through Shanghai's layered past — from the canals of Zhujiajiao to the neon towers of Lujiazui.
meta.note: Ink-wash art direction: textured paper, gray-green ink, mist, serif typography, red seal chapter markers.

chapters.label: Zhujiajiao
chapters.title: Mist on the Canals
chapters.subtitle: Zhujiajiao water town
paragraphs: The water town wakes before the city does.
Boats drift beneath stone arches older than empires, and the canal holds the first gray-green light of morning.

chapters.label: Wukang Mansion
chapters.title: The Normandie Apartments
chapters.subtitle: Wukang Road
paragraphs: On a wedge of land where five roads meet, Hudec's brick ship sails the plane-tree shade.
Art deco in old Shanghai — a corner of the city that forgot to hurry.

chapters.label: Yuyuan Garden
chapters.title: A Garden for Peace
chapters.subtitle: Old City
paragraphs: Pan Yunduan spent nineteen years folding rock into mountains and water into ponds.
Koi turn beneath the zigzag bridge — slow geometry at the heart of the old city.

chapters.label: The Bund
chapters.title: Golden Hour on the Huangpu
chapters.subtitle: The Bund waterfront
paragraphs: At dusk the river turns to brass.
Granite façades and bank domes hold the last of the light, while the far shore begins to spark.

chapters.label: Lujiazui
chapters.title: The City of Light
chapters.subtitle: Pudong
paragraphs: Across the river, the future switched on.
Towers rise through the mist like brushstrokes of neon — Shanghai, drawn in ink, finished in light.
